item.title: Officials fear heavy Russian shelling of Kherson resumes on Monday
item.description: The pause ends late on 1 November. Soldiers say lorries, Grad launchers and drones show Russia is preparing a bigger attack.

item.title: Commission wants to triple Frontex to 30,000 officers and 11.8 billion euros
item.description: The plan adds a quick reaction force and a bigger role in returns. Member states and Parliament must still agree, and most states saw no need for a big enlargement in February.
